idea-plugin.name: Diagram Source Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
Navigate from local Mermaid class diagrams to Java classes and methods in IntelliJ IDEA.

  • Open project declarations, attached dependency sources, or decompiled JAR classes.
  • Resolve overloaded and inherited methods using fully qualified class and parameter mappings.
  • Use keyboard navigation and export a report of diagram navigation checks.
  • Process navigation locally with a project-scoped, authenticated loopback service; no telemetry.

Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.x with Java support. Open a trusted local HTML class diagram from Tools → Open Class Diagram with Source Navigation. The diagram must provide source mappings; arbitrary flowcharts are not supported. No Mermaid runtime is bundled.

中文：从本地 Mermaid 类图跳转到项目 Java 源码、依赖源码或反编译声明。导航在本机完成，不收集遥测。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.0: production-hardening release preparation.

  • Harden navigation request validation, cancellation, and local resource boundaries.
  • Add browser and PSI regression checks and a cross-platform release verification pipeline.
  • Unify version metadata and add reproducible offline archives, checksums, and publishing documentation.
